# Differential matrix for the reallocing arrays in G3's lib/ilist.c and the
# template list modules (lib/accept_ents.c ... lib/wait_args.c), at G3
# 47535543d83fbc5649d54b63b49e578f2b11ab1c.
#
# tools/lists-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the
# pinned sources and records its output in c-output.txt; TestMatchesC feeds it
# to the Go port and requires the same output. The whole file runs in one
# process, so lists and the RNG state carry from line to line.
#
# One operation per line; '#' starts a comment. Integers are read with
# strtol(s, NULL, 0).
#
#   master HEX            write the bytes HEX to ./randseed and load_seed() it
#   rnd LOW HIGH          legacy rnd() on the global digest
#   root                  cur = rng_seed(master)
#   of KEY TAG            cur = rng_stream_of(&cur, KEY, TAG)
#   MODULE SLOT OP ARGS   an operation on list SLOT (a, b or c) of MODULE
#                         (ilist, or a template module's name)
#
# A list operation prints its result, if any, then the list: "NULL", or
# "len N:" and the elements. Elements of the pointer lists are written as
# indexes k of the driver's objs array; the element is &objs[k] (0..255).
#
#   append V      <m>_append              fill N V   append V, V+1, ... V+N-1
#   prepend V     <m>_prepend             clear      <m>_clear
#   copy S        this = <m>_copy(S)      delete I   <m>_delete
#   len           <m>_len                 lookup V   <m>_lookup
#   reclaim       <m>_reclaim             remvalue V <m>_rem_value
#   scramble      <m>_scramble            shuffle    <m>_shuffle
#   add V         ilist_add               remuniq V  ilist_rem_value_uniq
#   shufflerng    ilist_shuffle_rng and exit_views_shuffle_rng on cur; prints
#                 the stream counter first

master 00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff
root
of 7 0x4c495354

# --- ilist
# A NULL list: length 0, lookup -1, clear and copy keep it NULL.
ilist a len
ilist a lookup 5
ilist a clear
ilist b copy a
ilist a shuffle
ilist a scramble
ilist a remvalue 5
ilist a reclaim
rnd 0 1000

ilist a prepend 7
ilist a clear
ilist a len
ilist b copy a
ilist b append 3
ilist a len
ilist a reclaim
ilist b reclaim
# Growth through several reallocs, then copy.
ilist a fill 40 10
ilist b copy a
ilist b len

ilist b lookup 200
# Delete at the front, the back and the middle.
ilist a delete 0

ilist a delete 17

ilist c append 5

trades c shuffle
rnd 0 1000
trades c append 8
trades c shuffle
trades c shuffle
trades c scramble
rnd 0 1000
trades a shuffle
trades a scramble
trades b shuffle
rnd 0 1000
trades a reclaim
trades b reclaim
trades c reclaim

# --- wait_args
# A NULL list: length 0, lookup -1, clear and copy keep it NULL.
wait_args a len
wait_args a lookup 5
wait_args a clear
wait_args b copy a
wait_args a shuffle
wait_args a scramble
wait_args a remvalue 5
wait_args a reclaim
rnd 0 1000
# Prepend into a NULL list, then clear: the list stays non-NULL.
wait_args a prepend 7
wait_args a clear
wait_args a len
wait_args b copy a
wait_args b append 3
wait_args a len
wait_args a reclaim
wait_args b reclaim
# Growth through several reallocs, then copy.
wait_args a fill 40 10
wait_args b copy a
wait_args b len
wait_args a append 200
wait_args b lookup 200
# Delete at the front, the back and the middle.
wait_args a delete 0
wait_args a delete 39
wait_args a delete 17
wait_args a prepend 1
wait_args a prepend 2
# Duplicates: lookup finds the first; rem_value takes them all.
wait_args c append 5
wait_args c append 6
wait_args c append 5
wait_args c prepend 5
wait_args c append 7
wait_args c append 5
wait_args c lookup 5
wait_args c lookup 7
wait_args c lookup 99
wait_args c remvalue 99
wait_args c remvalue 5
wait_args c remvalue 6
wait_args c remvalue 7
wait_args c len
wait_args c append 9
wait_args c reclaim
# Shuffles of 1, 2 and many elements, and their draws.
wait_args c append 4
wait_args c shuffle
rnd 0 1000
wait_args c append 8
wait_args c shuffle
wait_args c shuffle
wait_args c scramble
rnd 0 1000
wait_args a shuffle
wait_args a scramble
wait_args b shuffle
rnd 0 1000
wait_args a reclaim
wait_args b reclaim
wait_args c reclaim
